From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OnyxAI dedicated sizing request & provisional pool hold

Quick ask — OnyxAI (late-stage) just signaled expected go-live window the first week of July. They need a dedicated pool for inference (isolation required by procurement). Can infra ops run a capacity snapshot and tell me: current available A100-80GB equivalent inventory across "pre-prod/dedicated" pools, and whether we can provision a soft 30-day hold for ~12 GPUs (A100-80GB equiv) starting early July?

What I have from the customer (attached):
- traffic profile (sustained latency-sensitive qps spikes)
- short PoC deck

Quick details from the AE side:
- estimated sustained QPS: 200, peak 400 for 10-minute bursts
- median request token length: ~1,024 tokens (model: open-architecture 70B variant)
- target start: 2029-07-01
- isolation: dedicated pool required (no shared tenancy)
- contract: 6 month initial term with possible expansion

Need a reply by EOD so I can tell Carl (Onyx) whether we can hold capacity while legal/procurement finish paperwork. If soft-lock is possible, please include pool id(s) and expiration.

Attachments: [Attachment: Onyx_traffic_profile.csv (csv)], [Attachment: Onyx_poc_deck.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OnyxAI dedicated sizing request & provisional pool hold

Jordan — thanks for the summary and attachments. Quick clarifying questions before I run a full sizing check:
- Do they require physical isolation (dedicated GPU nodes) or logical (tenant isolation on same pool)?
- Is the 200 qps sustained across 24/7 or during business hours only?
- Any latency SLO target (p95 token latency or p99)?

Preliminary inventory snapshot (quick scan):
- Pool DED-PRE-03: 24 x A100-80GB equiv (12 free, 12 reserved across other committed deals)
- Pool DED-PROD-01: 40 x A100-80GB equiv (6 free, rest provisioned)
- Region US-WEST preferred for the customer

I can provision a soft-lock mechanism: we create a reservation token (non-billable) that marks N slots as "soft-reserved" for up to 30 days. That prevents auto-scheduler from placing other committed workloads into those slots but doesn't deallocate physical nodes until firm commitment.

Proposed action:
1) If you confirm dedicated physical nodes required, I will pre-pull model artifacts onto DED-PRE-03 and mark 12 slots as soft-reserved.
2) Reservation token id: SOFT-ONYX-3581 (provisional, not active until SalesOps approves)
3) Soft-lock expiry: 2029-07-15 (30 days) unless SalesOps/AE request extension

I'll attach the capacity snapshot CSV for the full inventory and current reservations. Need confirmation on the isolation and expected run hours to give a final sizing read.

Attachments: [Attachment: capacity_snapshot_20290615.csv (csv)]

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Serving Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

- Pool: DED-PRE-03
